location.description: Location of the table's files in OneLake, Microsoft Fabric's storage, using IDs only: abfss://{workspaceId}@onelake.dfs.fabric.microsoft.com/{itemId}/Tables/{schema}/{table}, or .../Tables/{table} in a lakehouse without schemas. IDs are lowercase, with no trailing slash.

workspaceId.description: ID of the Fabric workspace that holds the item, in lowercase.

workspaceName.description: Name of the Fabric workspace that holds the item.

itemId.description: ID of the Fabric item that holds the table, such as a lakehouse or a warehouse, in lowercase.

itemName.description: Name of the Fabric item that holds the table.

itemType.description: Type of the Fabric item that holds the table, as Fabric names item types, for example Lakehouse, Warehouse or MirroredDatabase. Set only when the producer knows it.

tableId.description: ID of the table's Delta metadata (metaData.id in the Delta log), in lowercase. For a table reached through a shortcut, this is the ID of the target table.
